intent_challenge_id.description: Durable single-use Planning intent challenge. Repeat start with a fresh client.request_id and this exact identifier.

legal_next_step.description: Exact legal continuation after a blocked agent mutation, including the private resolver and the fresh follow-up Action when applicable.

material_classification.description: Prepare classification for a changed post-signoff canonical body. When Dish overrides a requested non-material classification, forced_material_reasons names every detected protocol reason.

forced_material_reasons.description: Exact protocol classifier reasons that forced the effective classification to material; empty when no override occurred.

planning_intent_confirmation.description: Durable first-call Planning confirmation challenge. It does not open an operation or acquire a lease.

request_id.description: The accepted mutation request UUID. Present on a replayed stored result.

request_replayed.description: True only when this response was reconstructed from the durable result of the exact same completed request.

required_admin_action.description: Exact private administrative Action required before the agent workflow may continue. It is not exposed in allowed_actions.

required_start_kind.description: Exact arguments.kind for the returned start action: planning starts Planning from a bare task; initial starts the first Research construction after Planning; verification starts independent Verification after Research. A planning-to-research handoff always requires kind=initial.

resolver.description: Required private Marco resolver for an administrative continuation.

retryable.description: Mechanical advice for a corrected or fresh call. It does not override exact request replay: reuse the same request_id only after response loss, and never retry BACKEND_UNCERTAIN as new work.

post.description: Replay-bound: request_id binds command, arguments, owner, and client.run_id. Exact replays return the stored success or failure across restarts. Changed reuse conflicts. Pending or uncertain work stays fail-closed and is not rerun.

correction.description: Approve the exact inspected candidate without supplying file_text.
Apply and approve a complete Small corrected candidate supplied as file_text.

request_id.description: Canonical lowercase UUID for one logical mutation. Dish durably binds it to the exact command, canonical arguments, authenticated owner, and client.run_id, stores the first authoritative success or expected failure, and preserves that result across service restart. Reuse it only for an exact replay after a lost response: the same identity returns the stored result with data.request_replayed=true and data.request_id. Changed arguments or reuse from a different command, owner, or run returns service_request_identity_conflict. A matching pending or uncertain request is not executed again and remains fail-closed until exact durable evidence supports reconstruction or safe resolution.
